P7p1: The Zapatistas are also the closest thing to a whole example that I found, because their autonomy goes beyond how they vote. They've set up their own education and health care, and their own justice. They run their own collective production and political formation. They've also worked out their own ways of teaching outsiders, all while coordinating beyond a single village.
